verdict.rationale: Kit documents real-time webhooks with per-endpoint signed deliveries and backoff retries, and its event-type list shows subscriber.unsubscribed and subscriber.bounced as available. The evidence shows no webhook events for sends, opens or clicks; those metrics are only available by polling the broadcast and account stats endpoints, which does not meet a webhook story. Missing for 10: send, open and click webhook event types; documented payload schemas for engagement events; independent or hands-on corroboration.
